initialization: Fresh parameters, matched within dataset/seed; original T24 fixed-corner optical geometry
uniform_half_filter: In each of the four experts project only cells with even row+column; the complementary checkerboard cells transmit the modulated field directly.

fiber_model.location: immediately following the selected expert phase screen, prior to joint free-space propagation and OEO

selection: Highest full VAL correct count, then lowest VAL cross entropy, then earliest epoch. TEST is diagnostic only.
interpretation: Matched trainable parameters, examples and updates. Fiber count, effective optical rank, insertion loss and numerical operation count change among the arms. Two training seeds; mixed diagonals are counterbalanced across them. Scalar coherent simulation.
